points.description: States that the problem is divided (broken down) into smaller subproblems (of the same type/smaller instances).
States that the subproblems are solved, typically recursively (independently, until a base case/simple enough to solve directly).
points.partial_credit: Half marks (0.75) if says subproblems are solved but does not mention recursion or base cases.

points.description: States that the solutions to the subproblems are combined (merged) to form the solution to the original problem.
